messages:
Maya: Heads up — seeing a fallback cascade starting ~14:26 UTC. Multiple EU tenants were routed to us-west-2 in quick succession and tripped variant quotas. Graph: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc/fallbacks?orgId=1

Maya: quick log snippet:```
2026-03-18T14:26:12Z ERROR routing: fallback to variant mosaic-q8-us-west (orig: mosaic-q8-eu) tenant=acme corp request_id=xyz quota_remaining=0
2026-03-18T14:26:13Z WARN routing: routing-loop-detected count=5 request_id=xyz
```

Sanjay: This smells like the new fallback shift we shipped yesterday (rollout 0.4.3). Canary had lower weights for eu variants so when RU/EU was saturated it kept flipping to US variants -> quota throttle -> back to EU -> repeat.

Kevin: Can confirm. Repro on staging with synthetic load. The core issue: fallback is immediate and unbounded. Need a time-decay or backoff on per-tenant fallback decisions. Right now fallback_count++ with no decay.

Alex: Proposal: implement a cooldown window per session_hash for N seconds after a fallback. Also add a backoff multiplier so the next fallback prefers a different region only after multiplier*base_cooldown.

Lina: We also need better telemetry. Current dashboards show global fallback_rate but not per-tenant or per-variant. Please add: fallback_rate_by_tenant, fallback_origin->target matrix, and rolling cooldown_count metric.

Maya: Agreed. Also the console rollout UX should surface "fallback behavior" toggle when deploying variant weights. Right now Ops can't see that the canary has aggressive cross-region fallbacks.

Paul: Quick mitigation: revert the canary weight change for mosaic-q8 in EU and enable a temporary circuit-breaker that blocks cross-region routing for tiered customers when fallback rate > 1% over 5m.

Kevin: On implement details: keep an in-memory per-tenant counter with timestamps; use exponential decay: score = sum(exp(-(now - t)/tau)) for fallback events; only allow fallback if score < threshold. Tau = 60s initial. This is cheap and avoids sticky state.

Sanjay: Suggest storing a compact token-bucket too: tokens refill at r per sec, fallback consumes k tokens. When empty, prefer local or return 503 depending on tenant tier.

Lina: Dashboard/alerts: create an alert if cross_region_fallback_rate > 0.5% for paying tier > 1m tokens/min. Add a heatmap for origin->target pairs.

Maya: UX note: on the Console rollout page add a preview panel that simulates routing decisions for 10 synthetic sessions so operators can see how fallbacks behave before enabling.

Alex: Also add variant compatibility matrix to the model catalog indicating latency tolerance and KV-cache compatibility. Some variants are incompatible and cause more fallbacks.

Paul: Ops-bot, create incident and page oncall if quota_throttle_rate > 2% for 3m.

ops-bot: Incident INC-592 created -> paging oncall (eng-platform) :rotating_light:

Maya: Short-term action list: 1) revert canary weights (Paul) 2) add cooldown timer in router (Kevin) 3) add per-tenant fallback metrics (Lina) 4) Console preview flag (Maya/UX) 5) add alert and incident runbook (Sanjay/Paul).

Sanjay: I'll draft a small design doc for cooldown/backoff by EOD. Will include math for tau and multiplier.

Kevin: I'll push a small gated change to router that implements decay score + config flag to disable for testing.

Lina: I'll spin up a dashboard PR with sample queries.

Maya: Thanks team. If anyone finds more impacted tenants drop them here and we will include in the postmortem. :thumbsup:
